study type: Comparative cross-sectional study of placental tissue
outcome: Expression of PD-1 on maternal macrophages and Hofbauer cells
Expression of PD-L1 on maternal macrophages
cohort: The study participants were pregnant individuals with preeclampsia and healthy pregnant individuals, whose placentas were analyzed.
finding: The expression of PD-1 on maternal macrophages and Hofbauer cells, PD-L1 on maternal macrophages (particularly in male offspring), and the numbers of CD68-positive and CD163-positive macrophages were significantly downregulated in the placenta of preeclamptic patients compared to healthy pregnancies.
